title: Unique Umami Portuguese Cod Skillet
description: A solo dinner Portuguese dish featuring cod, white vinegar, and a mantecare emulsify, cooked in a comal skillet with a yeasty and shaggy texture, this dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large comal skillet over medium heat
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant
Add the cod fillets, skin side up, and cook for 3-4 minutes, until browned
Flip the cod fillets and cook for an additional 3-4 minutes, until cooked through
In a small bowl, whisk together the white vinegar, dried thyme, salt, and black pepper
Pour the vinegar mixture over the cod fillets and cook for 1 minute
Stir in the dissolved yeast and chicken broth, and bring to a simmer
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 5 minutes, until the sauce has thickened and the cod is coated
Serve the cod and sauce hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired
